journey.title: Set up the kitchen
journey.purpose: Choose equipment through the tiles and scene, adjust a device's functions, see which future meals a removal affects, and change a required preference with its conflicts previewed.

steps.intent: Select appliances with the tiles and watch the scene reflect them.
Open a device's details from a scene marker or tile and set its functions.
Remove an appliance and review the affected future meals.
Change a required food rule and review its plan conflicts.
See affected occurrences flagged for repair rather than silently kept.

claims.statement: Selecting equipment updates immediately, persists, and never triggers image generation.
